title.zh: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange and its software developer over alleged IRGC Bitcoin transfers
title.en: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange and its software developer over alleged IRGC Bitcoin transfers

current_state.zh: The US Treasury's OFAC sanctioned Iranian crypto exchange BitBank, its software developer, and three Zanjani-linked individuals over alleged IRGC-linked Bitcoin transfers worth hundreds of millions of dollars.
current_state.en: The US Treasury's OFAC sanctioned Iranian crypto exchange BitBank, its software developer, and three Zanjani-linked individuals over alleged IRGC-linked Bitcoin transfers worth hundreds of millions of dollars.
